scope: Observation plan only; no workflow or source behavior change.
identity: Accept the next Root-supplied immutable Host SHA, Tree, Run, Attempt and Native pairing only.
Rebind each selected source blob to that actual activated tree before interpreting results. If the pending PR508 or cleanup files change, issue a distinct catalog revision.
Use only terminal original job metadata/logs and the original artifact from that exact run/attempt/head. Pipeline remains exclusive central status owner.
flutter: Read the one complete original machine stream exported by Pipeline; do not download it twice or rerun Flutter.
Preserve raw bytes, non-JSON lines, JSON arrays, stderr, process result and any original summary.

Resolve suite IDs to exact repository paths and testStart IDs to exact case names; require one successful, non-skipped, non-hidden testDone for every roster case. Loading/setup/teardown records do not satisfy a case.
Reject missing/duplicate/failed/skipped roster cases, error events, a missing or unsuccessful final done, or a nonzero/unknown child exit.

Count the complete visible suite from the actual stream and report hidden records separately. Compare any original acceptance-summary against the stream. Do not infer the full suite count by adding this roster to historical totals.

Separately retain the exact outcome of all 45 new cases, all 30 corrected old cases and the seven selected PR508 cases. Both newly added navigation sizes are explicitly included; any further test-file change requires another addendum.
host_compile: Obtain the terminal host-compile full job log and its artifact once after Pipeline supplies identities.
Check exact run/attempt/head and original artifact ID/name/size/digest; verify the entire ZIP, CRC and every member byte/hash.

Bind the actual compile invocation, process result, required class reports and source identities to the unchanged committed compile helper. A successful class report is not an Android runtime or audible-audio result.
Keep host-compile success separate from later build-contract execution and the full workflow conclusion.
speech_build_contracts: In the original complete build log, require actual successful completion of all three unchanged Python unittest methods. setUpClass failure, skips or absent methods cannot be converted into a pass.
Require each exact 23/17/30 marker from the corresponding real JVM process output, preserving stdout/stderr, original exit/failure data and the complete build result.
Do not accept a marker merely because it occurs in a printed command or source excerpt. A build error elsewhere remains an overall failure even if these three contracts pass.
Synthetic JVM German PCM/lifecycle/build guards are not English synthesis, Android playback or device acceptance.
release_boundary: This catalog creates no publication or release approval.
